channel.description: Notes on building small, focused macOS apps.

item.title: I Kept Missing Daily Standup. So I Built Meetly.
item.description: Calendar notifications weren’t enough. Here’s why I built Meetly — a macOS fullscreen meeting reminder that finally made daily standup unmissable.

item.title: Presenting Meant Switching Apps. So I Built HoverBoard.
item.description: Annotating live on macOS meant quitting the share, opening another tool, and killing the room’s focus. Here’s why I built HoverBoard — draw, spotlight, freeze, and more, a hotkey away.
